# Provider conformance and capability parity (R5)

<!-- Generated by `npm run conformance -- --write-doc` from host/node/conformance. Do not edit by hand; CI checks it is current. -->

Which behaviors does the actual Rust FX execution path demonstrably support for each Easy-LLM provider, and what evidence proves it?

The path is: caller, FX validation, `fx_core::Execution`, `SingleAttemptCapability`, `fx-host` (WebAssembly), the Node host, Easy-LLM `generateOnce` / `streamOnce`, the provider adapter. Each adapter below is the real Easy-LLM adapter at the pinned release, run unmodified against a local mock of its endpoint. The mocks are reconstructed from what the adapters parse; **nothing here was established against a live provider**, and no live smoke result is recorded.

- Easy-LLM release: `@easy-llm/llm@0.10.2` (published to npm)
- Manifest: `host/node/conformance/manifest.json` (version 1.0.0), checked against the results by `npm run conformance`
- Cases: 34 cases, 167 provider runs (`host/node/conformance/cases.mjs`)

`supported` means every conformance case providing evidence for the feature passed. `unsupported` means a case demonstrates the gap and records it as a limitation. `unverified` means the evidence is missing or does not settle the question; the note says why. The manifest is descriptive. FX request validation, `SingleAttemptCapability` and the executor remain the only authority on what an attempt does.

## Matrix

| Feature | openai | openrouter | anthropic | google | ollama |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-streaming text generation (`text_generate`) | supported | supported | supported | supported | supported |
| Streaming text that can complete on provider evidence (`text_stream`) | supported | supported | supported | unsupported | supported |
| Finish reason on a collected response (verified before completing) (`finish_reason_generate`) | supported | supported | supported | supported | supported |
| Finish reason carried on a stream (`finish_reason_stream`) | supported | supported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported |
| Usage metadata on a collected response (`usage_generate`) | supported | supported | supported | supported | unsupported |
| Usage metadata on a stream (`usage_stream`) | unverified | unverified | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported |
| HTTP status propagation (`http_status`) | supported | supported | supported | supported | supported |
| Retry-After propagation (`retry_after`) | supported | supported | supported | supported | supported |
| Cancellation reaches the provider connection (`cancellation`) | supported | supported | supported | supported | supported |
| Output after the provider's terminal marker is ignored (`late_events_ignored`) | unsupported | unsupported | supported | unsupported | supported |
| A malformed stream chunk fails the attempt instead of being skipped (`malformed_chunks_reported`) | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | supported |
| Tool definitions (`tool_definitions`) | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported |
| Tool-call history (`tool_call_history`) | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported |
| Images (`images`) | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported |
| Generation options (`generation_options`) | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported |
| Structured output (`structured_output`) | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported |

## Evidence and limits by provider

### openai

Adapter: `createOpenAIAdapter`. Live provider: unverified.

| Feature | Status | Evidence (cases) | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text_generate` | supported | `generate-success`, `generate-empty-body`, `malformed-collected-response` |  |
| `text_stream` | supported | `stream-success`, `stream-empty-body`, `stream-empty-terminal`, `stream-no-finish`, `reset-mid-stream`, `cancel-mid-stream` |  |
| `finish_reason_generate` | supported | `generate-empty-body`, `finish-reason-generate`, `generate-no-finish` |  |
| `finish_reason_stream` | supported | `finish-reason-stream` |  |
| `usage_generate` | supported | `usage-generate` |  |
| `usage_stream` | unverified | `usage-stream` (limitation) | The adapter parses a usage chunk when the provider sends one, but its request does not ask for streamed usage (no stream_options). Whether a live provider sends it through this path is not established. |
| `http_status` | supported | `http-status`, `http-error-single-attempt` |  |
| `retry_after` | supported | `http-retry-after` |  |
| `cancellation` | supported | `aborted-before-dispatch`, `cancel-before-response`, `cancel-mid-stream`, `attempt-budget`, `abandon-from-observer` |  |
| `late_events_ignored` | unsupported | `late-chunks-after-terminal` (limitation) | The adapter reads to the end of input before yielding its terminal event, so text sent after the provider's own terminal marker joins the output. |
| `malformed_chunks_reported` | unsupported | `malformed-stream-lines` (limitation) | The client skips a stream line it cannot parse. Text carried only by such a line is lost without any signal; the attempt can still complete with verified evidence. |
| `tool_definitions` | unsupported | `refused-tool-definitions` (limitation) | Refused before dispatch (capability_unavailable, definitely_unsent): the FX path cannot offer a provider any tool. The adapters send tool names with empty schemas, which is not tool-definition support. |
| `tool_call_history` | unsupported | `refused-tool-call-history` (limitation) | Refused before dispatch: assistant tool calls and tool results cannot be replayed through this path. |
| `images` | unsupported | `refused-images` (limitation) | Refused before dispatch: the FX path carries text only. |
| `generation_options` | unsupported | `refused-generation-options` (limitation) | Refused before dispatch: no generation option is transported (the adapters send fixed values). |
| `structured_output` | unsupported | `refused-structured-output` (limitation) | Refused before dispatch: response formats cannot be requested. |

## Cases

Every case runs for every provider unless noted. A case also checks the universal invariants on each attempt it makes: at most one provider request, delivery never `definitely_unsent` once a request was made, a completion only with a verified finish, at most one finish and nothing after it, and the credential absent from the FX result.

| Behavior group | Case | What it establishes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FX invariants over provider output | `provider-claims-do-not-decide-the-outcome` | a provider that says it stopped for tool calls, without returning any, does not get a valid completion |
| FX invariants over provider output | `tool-proposals-are-data` | a tool call the provider returns is a proposal in the report; FX does not run it or accept it unoffered |
| 1 collected completion | `generate-success` | a collected completion: content, finish reason, usage, delivery, credentials |
| 2 streamed completion | `stream-success` | a streamed completion: ordered deltas, then a finish backed by provider evidence |
| 3 empty response | `stream-empty-body` | a successful stream with no bytes is an interrupted attempt, not an empty success |
| 3 empty response | `stream-empty-terminal` | a stream with a terminal marker and no text is a verified, empty completion |
| 3 empty response | `generate-empty-body` | a collected response that is not a response (no choices, no content, no finish reason) is not a success |
| 4 finish reason | `finish-reason-generate` | a collected response's finish reason maps deterministically; unknown values never become stop |
| 4 finish reason | `finish-reason-stream` | a streamed finish reason is carried where the adapter carries it |
| 5 no verified finish | `stream-no-finish` | a stream that ends without verified completion stays interrupted and keeps its partial output |
| 5 no verified finish | `generate-no-finish` | a collected response without a finish reason is interrupted, not completed with an invented one |
| 6 HTTP error, Retry-After | `http-status` | the HTTP status reaches FX and decides the category, never the message text |
| 6 HTTP error, Retry-After | `http-retry-after` | Retry-After in seconds reaches FX; an unusable value is dropped, not guessed |
| 6 HTTP error, Retry-After | `http-error-single-attempt` | a rate limit or a server error is not retried, redirected or fallen back from |
| 7 malformed response | `malformed-collected-response` | a collected response that is not JSON fails; it is never a completion |
| 7 malformed response | `malformed-stream-lines` | unparseable stream lines never surface as output and never create a terminal |
| 8 before a request is sent | `connect-refused` | a refused connection is a transport failure that stays possibly sent; fetch cannot prove nothing left the host |
| 8 before a request is sent | `invalid-request-before-dispatch` | requests that fail FX validation never reach the provider |
| 8 before a request is sent | `aborted-before-dispatch` | an attempt cancelled before the provider is invoked is definitely unsent |
| 8 before a request is sent | `refused-tool-definitions` | a request using tool definitions is refused as definitely unsent, before any provider request |
| 8 before a request is sent | `refused-tool-call-history` | a request using tool call history is refused as definitely unsent, before any provider request |
| 8 before a request is sent | `refused-images` | a request using images is refused as definitely unsent, before any provider request |
| 8 before a request is sent | `refused-generation-options` | a request using generation options is refused as definitely unsent, before any provider request |
| 8 before a request is sent | `refused-structured-output` | a request using structured output is refused as definitely unsent, before any provider request |
| 9 after invocation | `reset-before-response` | a connection dropped after the request, before any response, is possibly sent |
| 9 after invocation | `reset-mid-stream` | a connection dropped mid-stream keeps the partial output and confirms the response |
| 10 cancellation, late events | `cancel-before-response` | cancelling a pending request closes the connection; it is cancelled after invocation, never unsent |
| 10 cancellation, late events | `cancel-mid-stream` | cancelling mid-stream stops the attempt; what the provider writes afterwards changes nothing |
| 10 cancellation, late events | `attempt-budget` | the attempt budget cancels the request and is a timeout, possibly sent |
| 10 cancellation, late events | `abandon-from-observer` | an observer that returns false abandons the attempt; the request is closed |
| 10 cancellation, late events | `late-chunks-after-terminal` | output written after the provider's terminal marker does not change the outcome |
| 11 usage metadata | `usage-generate` | usage on a collected response: carried, partly carried, or dropped; never corrupting the outcome |
| 11 usage metadata | `usage-stream` | usage on a stream: carried only where the adapter reads it; missing or invalid usage never invalidates a verified completion |
| 12 one invocation | `single-invocation` | every kind of attempt makes exactly one provider request: success, error, reset, timeout, cancel |
